goal: Make the post-payment thank-you and destination offer reliable by confirming the outgoing whisper and retrying once when no outgoing confirmation is observed.
notes: Post-payment only. Preserve the existing trusted wallet-delta payment trigger and payer resolution. Hold each marketing whisper until CHAT_MSG_WHISPER_INFORM confirms the exact recipient/message; retry once after a bounded delay, then fail closed to avoid duplicate spam. No summon, invite, trade-accounting, native DLL or AH behavior is changed.
